statement: The 1957 Sumatera Tengah reorganization is an analytical boundary break; earlier Sumatera Tengah observations cannot be concatenated directly with later Sumatera Barat.
The qualified 1971 source-era Sumatera Barat population anchor is 2,789,822 persons; its 14 local source-era rows sum exactly to the province total.

Within the fixed June 2026 current-boundary CHIRPS frame, all 19 kabupaten/kota are wetter in 1998 than 1997; the geography-level increase ranges from 43.05% to 162.90%. This is a descriptive regional signal, not a station observation or causal ENSO estimate.
